title: take a deep breath
expression: Why don't we all just take a deep breath?

sentences.en: This is a stupid idea. This boy does not belong in our school.
sentences.ko: 말도 안 되는 생각이에요. 그 애는 우리 학교에 맞지 않아요.

sentences.en: Come on Vicky, it's just the first day. Why don't we all just take a deep breath here?
sentences.ko: 비키, 이제 겨우 첫날이잖아요. 다들 일단 심호흡부터 하시죠?

sentences.en: The hell with that. Five minutes into my math class, he questioned my credentials.
sentences.ko: 무슨 소리예요. 수학 수업 5분 만에 제 자격을 문제 삼았다고요.

sentences.en: How am I supposed to control a classroom when a kid accuses me of being in breach of the hygiene code?
sentences.ko: 애가 저더러 위생 규정 위반이라는데 어떻게 수업을 통제합니까?

sentences.en: Well, Hubert, it wouldn't kill you to shower a little more often.
sentences.ko: 글쎄요, 휴버트, 샤워 좀 자주 한다고 죽진 않아요.

sentences.en: George, you want to weigh in here?
Oral Roberts University is a wonderful school.
sentences.ko: 오럴 로버츠 대학교는 아주 훌륭한 학교예요.

sentences.en: He said I was intimidated by his intelligence, and then, he offered to be my "leader."
sentences.ko: 자기 지능에 제가 위축됐다면서, 자기가 제 '리더'가 되어주겠대요.
